title: Rules About Dining
synopsis: Learn about some important dining etiquette in China.

fullText.simplified:
餐桌上的讲究

    中国人的餐桌上有很多讲究，请客吃饭更是有很多需要注意的地方。
    比如，吃饭时，桌子上不能摆三盘菜。为什么不能摆三盘菜呢？这和古代的习俗有关系。在中国古代，人们都喜欢双数，俗话说：“好事成双”。人们不喜欢单数，尤其是三。“三”大多数和祭祀有关系。人们在祭祀祖先或者去世的亲人时，祭品的数量都是“三”。所以现实生活中，如果请客吃饭摆三盘菜会非常不礼貌。
    另外，在中国南方请客吃饭，第一道菜不能是豆腐，因为豆腐也表达的是对去世的人的怀念。还有就是给别人盛米饭的时候，不能把筷子插在米饭里，因为筷子插在米饭里也是为了纪念去世的人。
    你瞧！请客吃饭需要注意的地方还真不少，需要慢慢去了解和学习哦！
fullText.traditional:
餐桌上的講究

    中國人的餐桌上有很多講究，請客吃飯更是有很多需要注意的地方。
    比如，吃飯時，桌子上不能擺三盤菜。為什麼不能擺三盤菜呢？這和古代的習俗有關係。在中國古代，人們都喜歡雙數，俗話說：“好事成雙”。人們不喜歡單數，尤其是三。“三”大多數和祭祀有關係。人們在祭祀祖先或者去世的親人時，祭品的數量都是“三”。所以現實生活中，如果請客吃飯擺三盤菜會非常不禮貌。
    另外，在中國南方請客吃飯，第一道菜不能是豆腐，因為豆腐也表達的是對去世的人的懷念。還有就是給別人盛米飯的時候，不能把筷子插在米飯裡，因為筷子插在米飯裡也是為了紀念去世的人。
    你瞧！請客吃飯需要注意的地方還真不少，需要慢慢去了解和學習哦！

sentences.english: Chinese people have many rules about dining.
When inviting guests to dinner, there are many things you must pay attention to.

sentences.simplified: 比如，吃饭时，桌子上不能摆三盘菜。
sentences.traditional: 比如，吃飯時，桌子上不能擺三盤菜。

sentences.simplified: 为什么不能摆三盘菜呢？这和古代的习俗有关系。
sentences.traditional: 為什麼不能擺三盤菜呢？這和古代的習俗有關係。
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me bù néng bǎi sān pán cài ne zhè hé gǔ dài de xí sú yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: For example, when having a meal, there must not be three dishes on the table.

sentences.simplified: 在中国古代，人们都喜欢双数，俗话说：“好事成双”。
sentences.traditional: 在中國古代，人們都喜歡雙數，俗話說：“好事成雙”。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó gǔ dài rén men dōu xǐ huan shuāng shù sú huà shuō hǎo shì chéng shuāng
sentences.english: Why can’t there be three dishes? This is related to ancient customs.

sentences.simplified: 人们不喜欢单数，尤其是三。
sentences.traditional: 人們不喜歡單數，尤其是三。
sentences.pinyin: rén men bù xǐ huan dān shù yóu qí shì sān
sentences.english: In ancient China, people liked even numbers. As the saying goes: “good things come in pairs”.

sentences.pinyin: sān dà duō shù hé jì sì yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: People didn’t like odd numbers, especially the number three.

sentences.simplified: 人们在祭祀祖先或者去世的亲人时，祭品的数量都是“三”。
sentences.traditional: 人們在祭祀祖先或者去世的親人時，祭品的數量都是“三”。
sentences.pinyin: rén men zài jì sì zǔ xiān huò zhě qù shì de qīn rén shí jì pǐn de shù liàng dōu shì sān
sentences.english: In most cases, “three” is related to offering sacrifices to gods or ancestors.

sentences.simplified: 所以现实生活中，如果请客吃饭摆三盘菜会非常不礼貌。
sentences.traditional: 所以現實生活中，如果請客吃飯擺三盤菜會非常不禮貌。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xiàn shí shēng huó zhōng rú guǒ qǐng kè chī fàn bǎi sān pán cài huì fēi cháng bù lǐ mào
sentences.english: When people offer sacrifices to their ancestors or deceased relatives, the number of offerings is usually “three”.
So in real life, if you are inviting guests to dinner, it is extremely impolite to offer three dishes.

sentences.simplified: 另外，在中国南方请客吃饭，第一道菜不能是豆腐，
sentences.traditional: 另外，在中國南方請客吃飯，第一道菜不能是豆腐，
sentences.pinyin: lìng wài zài zhōng guó nán fāng qǐng kè chī fàn dì yī dào cài bù néng shì dòu fu

sentences.simplified: 因为豆腐也表达的是对去世的人的怀念。
sentences.traditional: 因為豆腐也表達的是對去世的人的懷念。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi dòu fu yě biǎo dá de shì duì qù shì de rén de huái niàn
sentences.english: In addition, when inviting guests to dinner in southern China, the first dish that is served must not be tofu, ..

sentences.simplified: 还有就是给别人盛米饭的时候，不能把筷子插在米饭里，
sentences.traditional: 還有就是給別人盛米飯的時候，不能把筷子插在米飯裡，
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu jiù shì gěi bié ren chéng mǐ fàn de shí hou bù néng bǎ kuài zi chā zài mǐ fàn lǐ
sentences.english: .. because tofu also conveys remembering the deceased.

sentences.simplified: 因为筷子插在米饭里也是为了纪念去世的人。
sentences.traditional: 因為筷子插在米飯裡也是為了紀念去世的人。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi kuài zi chā zài mǐ fàn lǐ yě shì wèi le jì niàn qù shì de rén
sentences.english: Furthermore, when serving rice to other people, you cannot stick chopsticks into the rice, ..
.. because sticking chopsticks into rice is also something people do to commemorate the deceased.

sentences.simplified: 你瞧！请客吃饭需要注意的地方还真不少，
sentences.traditional: 你瞧！請客吃飯需要注意的地方還真不少，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ qiáo qǐng kè chī fàn xū yào zhù yì de dì fang hái zhēn bù shǎo

sentences.simplified: 需要慢慢去了解和学习哦！
sentences.traditional: 需要慢慢去了解和學習哦！

sentences.english: You see! There are many things to pay attention to when inviting guests to dinner, ..
.. which you must slowly understand and learn!

raw.synopsis: Learn about some important dining etiquette in China.
sentence_translations: Chinese people have many rules about dining.
When inviting guests to dinner, there are many things you must pay attention to.
For example, when having a meal, there must not be three dishes on the table.
Why can’t there be three dishes? This is related to ancient customs.
In ancient China, people liked even numbers. As the saying goes: “good things come in pairs”.
People didn’t like odd numbers, especially the number three.
In most cases, “three” is related to offering sacrifices to gods or ancestors.
When people offer sacrifices to their ancestors or deceased relatives, the number of offerings is usually “three”.
So in real life, if you are inviting guests to dinner, it is extremely impolite to offer three dishes.
In addition, when inviting guests to dinner in southern China, the first dish that is served must not be tofu, ..
.. because tofu also conveys remembering the deceased.
Furthermore, when serving rice to other people, you cannot stick chopsticks into the rice, ..
.. because sticking chopsticks into rice is also something people do to commemorate the deceased.
You see! There are many things to pay attention to when inviting guests to dinner, ..
.. which you must slowly understand and learn!
